cohort: 30 women who delivered neonates at a center from September 2020 to December 2020
finding: While breast ultrasound texture analysis did not differ between cesarean and vaginal delivery groups, cesarean section was independently associated with lower total human milk production and higher breast engorgement pain.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was independently associated with less successful breastfeeding, indicated by lower total human milk production and higher breast engorgement pain.
